name: Movies & Entertainment
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on movies & entertainment — practice these key phrases out loud:
Have you seen that new movie yet?
What kind of movies do you usually enjoy?
The ending completely took me by surprise.
I'd give it a solid eight out of ten.
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
